prompt:

Four small tactical battle sprites enlarged with nearest-neighbour appearance, not inventory illustration. ONE true asymmetric recurved bow: pale gray bent wood upper limb longer than lower, indigo winding at middle, small muted red knot at lower tip. ONE clearly visible taut straight LIGHT SLATE-INDIGO BLUE string joins both limb tips in EACH of four views. Never dotted, translucent, near-black or hairline. All four complete bows retain the longer upper limb, shorter lower limb, central blue winding and red knot. Top-left leaning left, top-right right; bottom-left left facing near-vertical arc, bottom-right right facing near-vertical arc. No stock, crossbar, arrow or loose thread.
